title: Physiological Word Distance
description: Stimulus words are embedded by non-voluntary Hume response signatures. Field height is response energy, boundary is local response-gradient/isolation, residual is deviation from the group mean for the same stimulus, and time traces follow stimulus order.

axes.projection: classical MDS over physiological response distance
axes.distance: cosine distance over baseline-corrected modality x emotion response signature
axes.field: normalized baseline-corrected response energy; also mapped to z height
axes.boundary: local response-energy gradient plus local isolation in participant response space
axes.residual: distance from the same-stimulus group mean response signature

alignment.wordAnchors: not used; stimulus words are primary distance nodes
alignment.sessionMapping: per-participant sorted materialized Hume registry files mapped to sorted session starts

spiritLayers.field: node z/size encodes non-voluntary response energy
spiritLayers.boundary: halo marks high local gradient or isolated response regions
spiritLayers.membrane: personal and collective response membranes mark fluid high-gradient boundary surfaces
spiritLayers.wall: red outer ring marks high-boundary/high-residual hard barriers
spiritLayers.void: dark void markers indicate low-field but locally isolated regions
spiritLayers.residual: node color shifts toward magenta when the participant differs from the same-word group response
spiritLayers.time: green trace links connect the participant's stimulus sequence

physicsLayers.phaseField: phi: soft membrane order parameter from boundary, residual, and response density
physicsLayers.diffuseInterface: interface width proxy phi*(1-phi), high where membrane is soft and transitional
physicsLayers.rho: response-energy density from baseline-corrected non-voluntary response energy
physicsLayers.cahnHilliard: discrete chemical-potential proxy phi^3 - phi - epsilon^2 laplacian(phi)
physicsLayers.levelSet: signed level-set proxy phi - median(phi), positive inside high membrane field
physicsLayers.homology: local loop/cavity proxy from boundary, isolation, and neighbor closure
